# asmmap64.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

ASUS asmmap64 is a memory-mapping driver that exposes physical-memory mapping to user mode. A privileged caller can abuse the interface to read or modify kernel and physical memory.
- **UUID**: d0048840-970f-4ad5-9a07-1d39469d721f
- **Created**: 2023-01-09
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: fluffycats31 | [@fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@fluffycats31)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/4c016fd76ed5c05e84ca8cab77993961.bin" "Download" >}}
{{< tip "warning" >}}
This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "asmmap64.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create asmmap64.sys binPath=C:\windows\temp\asmmap64.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start asmmap64.sys
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
